selection: all R3-F1 cases with >=10 valid evaluation pairs and all 4 evaluation cameras; not selected for improvement
init_cloud: shared Pi3X training-only LiDAR cloud, voxel 0.02m; identical per-session hashes
eval_camera: same first-camera ARKit gauge from R3-F1; never optimized
claim: short-budget pose-only renderer diagnostic, not a full recipe or photorealism validation
criterion: paired per-view PSNR; provisional visual support only if >=3/4 views improve and mean delta >=0.5 dB per session; SSIM/LPIPS and depth consistency also reported; no adoption on visual metrics alone
budget: one 4000-step run per arm, no sweep; no checkpoint selected by heldout score
amendment: Before any training step completed: DN-Splatter depth-normal code has incompatible grids with num_downscales=2 (691200 vs 43200 pixels). All arms use num_downscales=0/full resolution; other settings unchanged. Original failed run preserved.
